notes.title: Mirth Melody Version 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Mirth folks!

The latest update for Mirth Melody is finally here! We've done our best to address the issues posted on the discussion forum. Here are the changes:

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added French localization by Miel/M.E
[*] Added a glyph icon and instruction for throwing items
[*] Added a new option for changing screen resolution
[*] Added a new option to enable/disable full-screen mode
[*] Added a new option for adjusting graphic quality
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized shaders for better performance
[*] Slightly improved optimization in the forest scene
[*] Updated some note timings to better sync with the music
[*] Fixed a bug causing the menu to become unresponsive when quitting during the rhythm game
[/list]
[h3]Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you're having difficulty pressing 3 buttons simultaneously, it might be due to a limitation of your keyboard hardware. Since this is a hardware issue, we won’t include 3 simultaneous notes in future updates.
[/list]

If you encounter any further issues, please post them on the discussion forum.

Thank you for your continued support, and see you next time!

Best regards,
Clay Game Studio

notes.title: A Thank You Message
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066284/439a37b355190a840ac9757be545533f3198cfc5.gif[/img]

Hey, Mirth Folk!

We just wanted to say a [b]HUGE THANK YOU[/b] for all the love and support since the game launched! We didn’t expect so many of you to jump in and play. It’s been amazing to see everyone diving into the game, and your feedback means everything to us.

We’ve noticed a few common questions, so here’s a quick Q&A to keep you in the loop:

[b]Q: Will there be more content updates?[/b]
A: Absolutely! But right now, we’re focused on fixing a few issues. New songs (and content) will come a bit later.

[b]Q: The game sometimes gets laggy. Can you fix this?[/b]
A: Yeah, that’s on us. We didn’t test it enough on weaker devices. We’re working on optimizing it for the next patch.

[b]Q: Why aren’t the notes synced with the beats accurately?[/b]
A: We’re fixing this in the next update!

[b]Q: Can I change the resolution? It doesn’t look great on a widescreen.[/b]
A: We’ve got a fix coming in the next update.

[b]Q: I know this game is part of the bigger game called Mirth Island. Will playing Mirth Melody spoil Mirth Island for me?[/b]
A: Not at all! We’ve got different dialogues and songs for both games, so you’re safe.

[b]Q: How can I share my feedback?[/b]
A: Posting on the Steam forum is perfect! If you’re having any issues, please give us a chance to fix them before leaving a negative review ːsteamsadː. The Steam forum [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1721960/discussions/]link is here[/url].

[b]Q: After playing Mirth Melody for some time, I’m excited for Mirth Island! How can I find the game so I can wishlist it?[/b]
A: We got you! Here’s the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2410360/Mirth_Island/]link to Mirth Island[/url].

Thanks for being part of this journey. Stay tuned for more!

Cheers,
Clay Game Studio
